apps.name: Marketel Front Desk
apps.subtitle: Run your property from your phone.
apps.localizedDescription: Marketel Front Desk for iPhone, connected to your live property data over Wi-Fi or cellular. Version 3.14 makes guest emails and card-hold actions durable, visible, and safely retryable.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds durable retries for guest confirmation, release, and cancellation actions; shows a compact post-activation readiness check; surfaces delayed provider work without making false completion claims; and measures whether installed guest apps actually enabled notifications.

Adds owner-controlled no-answer rules: keep the booking to protect revenue or release the request to protect availability. New booking alerts, countdown cards, Front Desk Assistant texts, the sales reveal, and native onboarding now explain and enforce the selected rule end to end.
Renders the Marketel Front Desk contact photo directly from its vector mark at high resolution so the logo appears crisp and correctly positioned in iOS Contacts.
Redesigns native onboarding with Marketel's premium visual system, animated guidance, clearer Front Desk Assistant setup, and a polished walkthrough of the four operational areas.

Adds native-safe room, availability, and booking dialogs; replaces the jumping add-room form with a focused modal; opens live booking-page previews inside Marketel; redesigns Guest Messages with an expandable conversation workspace; and fixes phone-number dialing.
Replaces the temporary onboarding mark with the real Marketel logo, adds Front Desk Assistant directly to the iPhone three-dot menu, and renames How it works to the clearer Replay app tour action.

Adds native first-run onboarding built for iPhone, previews Front Desk Assistant, opens a prefilled Apple contact for Marketel Front Desk, walks through all four native tabs, resumes safely after interruption, and replays from How it works. Notification permission now waits until the owner has context.

Adds an eight-second startup timeout, automatically falls back to the established loading path, preserves the signed-in session on temporary network failures, provides a working retry state, and labels localhost as the normal bundled-app host.
Fixes iPhone sign-in for Jack’s Inn with the restricted dogfood codes, keeps the selected property context exact, and prevents a login from silently falling back to a different hotel.

Substantially faster Front Desk startup. Essential property, booking, and availability data now load together while secondary maintenance, notification, property-list, conflict, and growth work waits until after the first screen is usable.
Fixes the returning-subscriber login crash caused by tour cleanup running before its lazy-loaded module existed.

Bundles the complete Front Desk into the iPhone app, adds active-subscriber sign-in, property-aware navigation, privacy and account deletion controls, and native booking-notification support. Native APNs delivery requires a push-enabled Apple profile and the production backend APNs configuration.

Makes the native header match the rounded tab bar, keeps its contents stable after closing the three-dot menu, removes native chrome while Front Desk Assistant is open, adds retryable loading, and opens a prefilled Apple contact form with the Marketel logo and Front Desk number.

Reduces the native app to four main tabs, moves Revenue inside Bookings, and adds the Front Desk Assistant setup and activity experience. Verified SMS booking alerts and plain-language availability updates become active when the backend Twilio number is connected.

Replaces the separate native header capsules with one roomy, full-width Liquid Glass banner. The status area now matches the page background, long property names truncate cleanly, and every tab receives consistent header spacing.
Restores Revenue for eligible properties and moves the compact logo, Front Desk title, property switcher, QR, and menu into a safe-area-aware native header below the iPhone status area.
Native iOS navigation, safe-area and scrolling fixes, property sign-in and switching, synced badges, and a cleaner Guest App workspace.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Front Desk uses the camera when you choose to add a property or room photo.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Front Desk lets you save the Marketel messaging number as a contact.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Front Desk uses your photo library when you choose a property or room photo.
